roads.name: Dolliver Park Avenue
words: Properly twisty: 24 curves in 3.6 miles, about 7 a mile.
From 943 to 1,123 ft, with 443 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 20 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.13 g.
